interpretation: Both CI browser jobs reached make test-e2e; recorded dependency installation and build steps succeeded. They failed on actual browser tests, not environment setup.

The first remote failure is imports-policy.spec.ts:61 missing the current-course-directory region after reload; the second is imports.spec.ts:111 missing the initial-learning-goal heading. Both are also the first two local failures.
Remote workbench.spec.ts:5 reaches its own initial-heading assertion; local run instead fails in helpers.ts:24 saved-session bootstrap.

Remote subsequent synthetic-reader entry failures wait for the browse-synthetic-course button, usually at helpers.ts:27, with 30 s test timeout; local corresponding failures stop earlier at helpers.ts:24 with a 5 s saved-session assertion.
Remote zoom reports only a 30 s test timeout in its failure block, so no exact failing locator or helper line is inferred for it.

Eight failures seen locally are absent from both remote failure sets: four earlier practice/reader/review cases and four workbench cases. This difference is not proof they were fixed, and no source changes occurred in these fixed-SHA executions.

Logs identify failed assertions and timing; they do not establish a shared causal bug or a residual independent attempt. Root reports its separate local DB inspection found zero attempts; this reviewer did not inspect that DB.
Raw GitHub logs and raw check/run/PR records remain under temporary paths and were not copied to the repository.
